decisions.statement: A seat's name is the domain followed by the role followed by the flex.
The persona a seat begins with is read from the seat's page type.
A seat's flex is in its name rather than beside the seat.
A seat's name spells no on-call assignment.
A seat's name and its terminal tab name and its Remote Control session title are one value.
A seat name is never ambiguous.
The narrower reading wins where more than one set of stated values would spell one name.
A seat name reaches the seat that had the name most recently.

definition: the name a seat goes by
